capabilities: Fetch today's completed tasks from Todoist
Fetch completed tasks for the last N hours
Fetch tasks using dates from segments with Templater support
Insert tasks between start and end markers in a note
Customize task prefix and postfix with Obsidian Tasks support
extras: README links to separate docs for features plan, known bugs, advanced usage and API token setup; includes a donate link.
problem: Obsidian cannot display tasks completed in an outside service like Todoist inside your notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is heavily influenced by the Todoist Text plugin.

summary: Fetches completed tasks from a Todoist account and inserts them into a note between start and end markers.
